title: Home as Shopfront and Board: one hero card, mode tabs, one Play button, bottom navigation
problem: Home holds the stall, goals, three swiping mode cards and four mode buttons; the owner wants one focused card and one Play button, with the stall and the rules on their own tabs.
scope: MARKET tab (Home): title, a profile chip (face, name, level, rank, a settings gear), one hero card for the chosen mode, mode tabs Custom, League, Daily, Sprint, and one Play button for the chosen mode (Continue when that mode has a saved game)
Custom is today's Play (normal game: quick match, private room, computer, one phone)
STALL tab: the player's stall with its looks, Stamp book, Wardrobe, next goals and the account
exclusions: No rule, save or mode change
Illustrated art stays (League stage pictures, Daily customer card, faces)
